Introducing Motion Anime. A curated collection of springs, skids, fluid micro-interactions for your UI. Now you can add beautiful, interactive charts to your app with a single CLI command. Part of Amicro. Open source. Try it: http://amicro.vercel.app/Anime

Designer: @SubhanHQ. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
